title: The Asking Papa to Listen
youtube_title: The Asking Papa to Listen | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Zola feels shy about asking Papa to listen before the day ended. Instead of pretending not to care, Zola tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
